create_Vectorize_for_objective: create a Vectorize instance for an Objective to enable batch cost function vectorization
create_CostFunctionWrapper: create a _CostFunctionWrapper to cache weighted errors and jacobians for a cost function
get_cost_function_schema: get the cost function schema tuple identifying variable types and shapes for grouping
vectorize_retract_optim_vars: vectorize and retract optimization variables in batch using a delta tensor and manifold ordering
set_vectorization_mode: set the _VectorizationMode enum to ERROR, WEIGHTED_ERROR, or FULL to control computation scope
